description: A set of three antique wooden occasional tables, each with a scalloped top edge and slender, tapering legs. The tables vary slightly in design and finish, suggesting they might be a matching set or from a similar era. One table features a small drawer with a subtle pull, while another has a brass trim around its edge. The wood appears to be a warm, rich brown, exhibiting a subtle grain. The overall design is elegant and refined, suitable for accent pieces in a well-appointed room.
